note: Realigned to epics-from-prd.md's actual story text and IDs (previously an independently-invented STORY-1..11 set covering the same ground with different wording). Only the 6 MVP-committed features (E1.F1-F4, E2.F2, E2.F3) are elaborated here — the just-in-time boundary from cycle-plan.md. epics-from-prd.md's stories for the other 7 features remain listed (title only) in epics.json but are not elaborated with AC/Work Units in this phase.

stories.title: Generate SEC Form 4 after trade
stories.i_want: the system to automatically generate a pre-filled SEC Form 4 after I execute a trade
stories.so_that: I can comply with regulatory deadlines without manual effort
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a valid securities transaction is executed WHEN the transaction is recorded THEN a pre-filled SEC Form 4 is generated within 5 minutes
GIVEN a transaction is missing required data WHEN form generation is triggered THEN the system flags the form as incomplete and notifies the legal team

stories.title: Bulk form generation for multiple trades
stories.i_want: the system to generate separate forms for each trade when multiple trades occur in a short timeframe
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN several trades are executed within 10 minutes WHEN the system processes transactions THEN a separate SEC Form 4 is generated for each trade
stories.mvp_note: Not built — see E3.F2 Edge Case Handling for Rapid Trade Succession, also not built in MVP; listed here for traceability to epics-from-prd.md, not elaborated into a Work Unit.

stories.title: Handle incomplete transaction data
stories.i_want: to be notified if a form cannot be generated due to missing data
stories.so_that: I can resolve the issue before the filing deadline
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a transaction is missing required fields WHEN form generation is attempted THEN the system notifies the legal team with details of missing data

stories.title: Validate form fields before submission
stories.i_want: the system to validate all form fields before submission
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN all required fields are correctly filled WHEN the form is submitted THEN submission proceeds
GIVEN a required field is missing or invalid WHEN the form is submitted THEN submission is blocked and an error message is displayed

stories.title: Update validation logic for regulatory changes
stories.i_want: to update validation rules when SEC requirements change
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN SEC changes form requirements WHEN validation logic is updated THEN all new forms are validated against new rules
stories.mvp_note: Validation rules are code-defined (ValidationService.java), not admin-configurable, in the MVP — this story describes a future extensibility need, not built.

stories.title: Edit pre-filled form before submission
stories.i_want: to edit pre-filled forms before submission
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a pre-filled form is generated WHEN I edit a field THEN changes are saved and validated
GIVEN I enter invalid data WHEN the form is saved THEN a validation error is displayed

stories.title: Approve form for submission
stories.i_want: to approve forms before they are submitted
stories.so_that: only accurate filings are sent to regulators
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a form passes validation WHEN I approve it THEN the form is marked ready for submission

stories.title: Audit log edits and approvals
stories.i_want: all edits and approvals to be logged
stories.so_that: I can review the compliance trail
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a user edits a form WHEN the edit is saved THEN the action is logged with timestamp and user ID

stories.title: View historical filings and statuses
stories.i_want: to view my historical filings and their statuses
stories.so_that: I have an audit trail for compliance
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I am authorized WHEN I access filing history THEN the system displays all my filings and statuses

stories.title: Audit log access for compliance
stories.i_want: to access audit logs for all form actions
stories.so_that: I can support internal and external audits
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I am authorized WHEN I request audit logs THEN the system provides logs with timestamps and user IDs

stories.title: Notify executive of form generation
stories.i_want: to receive a notification when a regulatory form is generated
stories.so_that: I am aware of compliance actions
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a form is generated WHEN notification is triggered THEN the executive receives a notification

stories.title: Alert on filing deadline risk
stories.i_want: to be alerted if a filing deadline is at risk of being missed
stories.so_that: I can take action to avoid penalties
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN less than 12 hours remain to the (EDGAR-cutoff-adjusted) deadline WHEN the form is not submitted THEN a warning notification is sent

stories.title: Confirm successful submission
stories.i_want: to receive confirmation when a filing is successfully submitted
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a form is submitted WHEN submission completes THEN a confirmation notification is sent

stories.title: Monitor filing statuses in dashboard
stories.i_want: to monitor all filing statuses in a dashboard
stories.so_that: I have real-time visibility into compliance
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I access the dashboard WHEN it loads THEN all filings and statuses are displayed

stories.title: Display error alerts in dashboard
stories.i_want: to see error alerts in the dashboard
stories.so_that: I can respond to compliance issues immediately
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a filing error is detected WHEN the dashboard is refreshed THEN an error alert is shown
